module Splice.Scripts.TestSvStatus where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time

import Daml.Script

import Splice.Types
import Splice.Scripts.DsoTestUtils
import Splice.DsoRules
import Splice.DSO.SvState


-- test status report submission, as status report invariants are tested
-- in the onboarding tests using 'checkSvContractInvariants'
testStatusReportSubmission : Script ()
testStatusReportSubmission = do

  (_, dso, (sv1, sv2, _, _)) <- initMainNet

  [(dsoRulesCid, _)] <- query @DsoRules dso

  now <- getTime

  let mkTime i = addRelTime now (convertMicrosecondsToRelTime i)
  let dummyStatus dummyNr = SvStatus with
        createdAt = now
        cometBftHeight = dummyNr + 1
        mediatorSynchronizerTime = mkTime $ dummyNr + 2
        participantSynchronizerTime = mkTime $ dummyNr + 3
        latestOpenRound = Round (dummyNr + 4)
  let getStatusReport sv = do
        [report] <- queryFilter @SvStatusReport dso (\report -> report.sv == sv)
        pure report
  let submitStatusReport sv svName dummyNr = do
        (previousReportCid, prevReport) <- getStatusReport sv
        submitMulti [sv] [dso] $ exerciseCmd dsoRulesCid DsoRules_SubmitStatusReport with
          sv
          previousReportCid
          status = dummyStatus dummyNr
        (_, actualNewReport) <- getStatusReport sv
        let expectedNewReport = SvStatusReport with
              dso
              sv
              svName
              number = prevReport.number + 1
              status = Some (dummyStatus dummyNr)
        expectedNewReport === actualNewReport

  submitStatusReport sv1 "sv1" 10
  submitStatusReport sv2 "sv2" 20

module Splice.Scripts.TestSvStatus where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time (addRelTime, seconds)
import qualified DA.Map as Map
import Daml.Script

import Splice.DSO.SvState
import Splice.Types
import Splice.Util

test_SvStateContractGroups : Script ()
test_SvStateContractGroups = do
  dso <- allocateParty "dso"
  otherDso <- allocateParty "other-dso"
  sv <- allocateParty "sv"
  otherSv <- allocateParty "other-sv"
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 3
        numRoundsCollected = 7
        lastRoundCollected = Round 12
        numCouponsIssued = 17
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = "alpha"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = "alpha"; state = node
      report = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = "alpha"; number = 5; status = None

  contractGroupId rewardState === (ForSv with dso; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSv with dso = otherDso; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (rewardState with svName = "beta") === (ForSv with dso; svName = "beta")

  contractGroupId nodeState === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (nodeState with svName = "beta") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = "beta")

  contractGroupId report === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (report with dso = otherDso) === (ForSvNode with dso = otherDso; sv; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (report with sv = otherSv) === (ForSvNode with dso; sv = otherSv; svName = "alpha")
  contractGroupId (report with svName = "beta") === (ForSvNode with dso; sv; svName = "beta")

test_SvStateContracts : Script ()
test_SvStateContracts = do
  dso <- allocateParty "dso"
  sv <- allocateParty "sv"
  stranger <- allocateParty "stranger"
  now <- getTime
  let reward = RewardState with
        numRoundsMissed = 2
        numRoundsCollected = 4
        lastRoundCollected = Round 9
        numCouponsIssued = 11
      node = NodeState with synchronizerNodes = Map.empty
      status = SvStatus with
        createdAt = now
        cometBftHeight = 123
        mediatorSynchronizerTime = addRelTime now (seconds 3)
        participantSynchronizerTime = addRelTime now (seconds 7)
        latestOpenRound = Round 8
      rewardState = SvRewardState with dso; svName = "sv-name"; state = reward
      nodeState = SvNodeState with dso; sv; svName = "sv-name"; state = node
      initialReport = SvStatusReport with dso; sv; svName = "sv-name"; number = 0; status = None
      nextReport = initialReport with number = 1; status = Some status

  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd rewardState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd nodeState
  submitMustFail sv $ createCmd initialReport

  rewardCid <- submit dso $ createCmd rewardState
  nodeCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nodeState
  initialCid <- submit dso $ createCmd initialReport
  nextCid <- submit dso $ createCmd nextReport

  Some fetchedReward <- queryContractId dso rewardCid
  fetchedReward === rewardState
  Some fetchedNode <- queryContractId dso nodeCid
  fetchedNode === nodeState
  Some fetchedInitial <- queryContractId dso initialCid
  fetchedInitial === initialReport
  Some fetchedNext <- queryContractId dso nextCid
  fetchedNext === nextReport

  None <- queryContractId @SvRewardState sv rewardCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvNodeState sv nodeCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport sv initialCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport sv nextCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvRewardState stranger rewardCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvNodeState stranger nodeCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport stranger nextCid

  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submitMustFail sv $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd rewardCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nodeCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd initialCid
  submit dso $ archiveCmd nextCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvRewardState dso rewardCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvNodeState dso nodeCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso initialCid
  None <- queryContractId @SvStatusReport dso nextCid
  pure ()
